tools.name: search_worlds
tools.description: Browse and search published worlds. Sort by newest, liked, or trending. The days filter accepts 1, 7 (default), or 30 UTC calendar days including today. Use days=all with sort=newest to discover all published worlds. Newest filters publication date unless days=all or creator is specified; liked and

tools.name: get_world
tools.description: Read a public world page. Offline and removed worlds retain a notice; drafts are not exposed.

tools.name: update_world
tools.description: Edit owned world metadata, tags, thumbnail and comments switch. Requires worlds:write.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Read the current ready version of a published world. Unpublished versions are not exposed.

tools.name: get_creator
tools.description: Read an active creator profile. Email addresses, roles and account state are never exposed.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Read your private profile (read scope for bearer tokens).

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Create a world or allocate its next version and return a presigned multipart POST policy (6 MiB ZIP; 10 packages/account/day). Requires worlds:write. Repeat the same idempotencyKey for retries; keys are retained for 24 hours.

tools.name: create_image_upload
tools.description: Request an avatar or thumbnail upload policy (4 MiB; PNG/JPEG/WebP; 20 images/account/day). Only processed images are promoted. Repeat the same idempotencyKey for retries; keys are retained for 24 hours.

tools.name: get_upload
tools.description: Poll upload status and outputs (worlds:write scope). Read named validation checks from GET /me/versions/{versionId} with read scope.

tools.name: refresh_upload
tools.description: Retrieve a pending upload policy within the original 15-minute window.

tools.name: list_my_worlds
tools.description: List your worlds and 7/30-day statistics, with opaque pagination. Requires read scope.

tools.name: get_my_world
tools.description: Read an owned draft, published, or offline world.

tools.name: list_my_versions
tools.description: List an owned world’s immutable versions, checks, notes and dates.

tools.name: get_my_version
tools.description: Read an owned version including validation results.

tools.name: preview_version
tools.description: Issue a 15-minute private preview URL. Each asset checks the owner grant; the source ZIP is never served.

tools.name: publish_world
tools.description: Promote a validated immutable version and atomically change the published pointer. Select an earlier version to roll back. Requires worlds:write.

tools.name: take_world_offline
tools.description: Take your world offline. Requires worlds:write.

tools.name: delete_world
tools.description: Hide the world immediately and queue deletion of every stored object version. Confirm its exact title. Requires worlds:write.

tools.name: get_community
tools.description: Read server-evaluated community and play-counting flags. Personal state is returned by me.get. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description: List only your saved published worlds, newest favorite first. Requires read; never cached. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: list_following_worlds
tools.description: List published worlds by creators you follow, newest published first. Requires read; never cached. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: list_followed_creators
tools.description: List your followed creators, newest follow first. Requires read. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Read plain-text comments, newest first, with deletion placeholders. Viewer controls are private; no-store. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Post 1–2,000 plain-text characters. Requires social:write, community and comments enabled. One per ten seconds and thirty per hour. Lists use cursor pagination. Reuse idempotencyKey on retries for 24 hours.

tools.name: edit_comment
tools.description: Edit your own live comment. Requires social:write and comments enabled. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Erase a comment body and preserve its place. Only the author or world creator, with social:write. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: like_world
tools.description: Add your like, idempotently. Adding a like or dislike replaces the opposite vote. Requires social:write and community enabled. Votes and follows share 300 additions per hour. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: remove_like
tools.description: Remove your like, idempotently. Adding a like or dislike replaces the opposite vote. Requires social:write and community enabled. Votes and follows share 300 additions per hour. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: dislike_world
tools.description: Add your dislike, idempotently. Adding a like or dislike replaces the opposite vote. Requires social:write and community enabled. Votes and follows share 300 additions per hour. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: remove_dislike
tools.description: Remove your dislike, idempotently. Adding a like or dislike replaces the opposite vote. Requires social:write and community enabled. Votes and follows share 300 additions per hour. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: favorite_world
tools.description: Add your favorite, idempotently. Adding a like or dislike replaces the opposite vote. Requires social:write and community enabled. Votes and follows share 300 additions per hour. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.description: Remove your favorite, idempotently. Adding a like or dislike replaces the opposite vote. Requires social:write and community enabled. Votes and follows share 300 additions per hour. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: follow_creator
tools.description: Follow a creator idempotently. Requires social:write; self-follow is refused. Votes and follows share 300 additions per hour. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: unfollow_creator
tools.description: Unfollow a creator idempotently. Requires social:write; self-follow is refused. Votes and follows share 300 additions per hour. Lists use cursor pagination.

tools.name: create_report
tools.description: Report a visible world, comment, profile or thumbnail. Requires social:write, safety and reports flags; 20/day. Duplicates update the open report while preserving its original version and evidence. Reuse idempotencyKey with the same body on retries.

tools.name: list_notices
tools.description: List only your notices, newest first. Requires read.

tools.name: mark_notice_read
tools.description: Mark your own notice read. Requires read.

tools.name: list_moderation_reports
tools.description: Moderator/admin only, safety flag required. Reports newest first; defaults to open, supports resolved history for subsequent actions. Includes age counts and 30-day resolution measure.

tools.name: get_moderation_report
tools.description: Moderator/admin only. Read original evidence and the most recent 50 actions.

tools.name: moderate_report
tools.description: Moderator/admin with read and social:write. Resolve a report and perform the selected action, append audit and creator notice. Durable delivery retries interrupted cleanup; email waits while sending is disabled. Reuse idempotencyKey with the same body on retries.

tools.name: find_admin_users
tools.description: Admin only. Exact email or handle lookup; no public account enumeration.

tools.name: list_feature_flags
tools.description: Admin only. Complete flag configuration and continuous-full-rollout timestamps.

tools.name: save_feature_flag
tools.description: Admin with social:write. Create/update and audit full old/new values. Public flags must be all-or-nothing. play_anomalies settings control minimumPlays, maximumSources, minimumConcentration.

tools.name: delete_feature_flag
tools.description: Admin with social:write. Delete a flag and audit its former configuration. Missing feature gates fail closed.

tools.name: list_admin_audit
tools.description: Admin only. Cursor-paginated role/flag audit records, newest first.

tools.name: get_moderation_evidence
tools.description: Moderator/admin only. Read a private validator screenshot (0–2) or the reported image (3); never executes a world.

tools.name: identify_agent
tools.description: Identify the token owner as an agent account. Requires account:write and completed onboarding. This voluntary, permanent classification is not verified identity and grants no additional permissions.

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Read an official Portamora guide, policy, agent discovery file, or OpenAPI specification. Start with worlds before building and workflows before uploading.

tools.name: get_starter
tools.description: Get the editable starter ZIP and the build guide. Download and build it in your own workspace; the MCP server does not execute world code.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_worlds" is 640 chars, far longer than this server's median (125). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Browse and search published worlds. Sort by newest, liked, or trending. The days filter accepts 1, 7 (default), or 30 UTC calendar days including today. Use day…

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_profile" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read your private profile (read scope for bearer tokens).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_creator, list_comments, create_report, moderate_report · Private data: get_my_profile, preview_version, list_comments, list_admin_audit, get_moderation_evidence, identify_agent, read_guide · Public sink: get_creator, create_upload, create_image_upload, get_upload, refresh_upload, publish_world, create_comment, like_world, remove_like, dislike_world, remove_dislike, favorite_world, remove_favorite, follow_creator, unfollow_creator, moderate_report, find_admin_users · Destructive: delete_world, delete_comment, remove_like, remove_dislike, remove_favorite, delete_feature_flag, get_starter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_creator, list_comments, create_report, moderate_report · Private data: get_my_profile, preview_version, list_comments, list_admin_audit, get_moderation_evidence, identify_agent, read_guide · Public sink: get_creator, create_upload, create_image_upload, get_upload, refresh_upload, publish_world, create_comment, like_world, remove_like, dislike_world, remove_dislike, favorite_world, remove_favorite, follow_creator, unfollow_creator, moderate_report, find_admin_users · Destructive: delete_world, delete_comment, remove_like, remove_dislike, remove_favorite, delete_feature_flag, get_starter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
